meaning: Stage 2, group 2: God is altogether immutable (ST I q.9 a.1, first reason): whatever is God is maximal in being, hence the first being (open bridge STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-IS-FIRST-BEING, #194), and the first being is in potency in no respect (q.3 a.1), so God has no capacity for any change. Immutability is complete immutability (no potency), not present inactivity (Codex P1 on #199).
